radialModel: Use the baseline similarity to express the reference radial vector in target coordinates. Fit a single coefficient for the difference of that vector and the radial vector of the baseline-predicted target position, including on held-out stars, with a fresh simultaneous similarity fit.
partition: Exact corresponding training and held-out Gaia IDs from the common centroid sample. No held-out parameter fitting.
quadratic: Independent second-order polynomial for each target coordinate, using detector-centered normalized coordinates.
